ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

About WPP Production
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .
A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
What does a Senior Account Manager - [ 4Month - FTC ] do at WPP Production?
As part of the Client Services Department, you play a central role in the business and are pivotal to the smooth running of your account. You will be required to have a thorough understanding of all areas of the business and be responsible for managing projects from brief to final delivery on time and budget.

You will be client focused and require good communication, organisation and time management skills to manage both your clients and internal departments, while always focusing on quality, process and profitability.
What does a Senior Account Manager [ 4Month - FTC ] do at WPP Production, on the TJX account?
You will be working within the client's Activation Account team, implanted onsite working on behalf of the client. You will attend TJX office in Watford two/three times a week and occasionally work from the WPP Production office in London. You will deliver projects, working with TJX's onsite in-house creative team.

You will be responsible for managing projects from briefing to final delivery, ensuring that TJX stakeholders, clients and agencies, adhere to set timings to ensure a timely delivery of all projects. You will be working on a range of Digital Media projects, such as Web, Email and Paid Media

Immerse yourself in the client's brand and offering
Prepare client proposals

completion of a project

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry.

You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity.

With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

The Opportunity
MedMe powers more than 70% of Canada's national pharmacy chains and roughly 40% of all community pharmacies. We are now building that same presence in the US, with pharmacies live in 15 states and expanding rapidly.
Much of that growth runs through partnerships with state pharmacy associations and buying groups, which give us a direct channel to their members. You'll be selling into pharmacies that already have a reason to talk to us, across our core platform, billing, and AI products.
This is a high-volume sales role with fast cycles. Most of the selling happens remotely, over calls and demos, though you should be willing to get in front of pharmacy owners in person when that's what it takes to close.
You'll also be the voice of the customer inside the business. As you spend time with pharmacists, you'll bring their feedback back to our product team to help us continuously enhance our products.
About MedMe Health
At MedMe, we are passionate about empowering pharmacists to provide services beyond just prescribing. Our mission is to build an all-in-one cloud-based platform that enables pharmacists to schedule, document, and manage clinical services at scale. With over 4,500 pharmacies using our software, we've facilitated more than 25 million patient services, transforming pharmacies into community health hubs across North America.

Sell MedMe's core platform, billing, and AI products into independent and small-chain pharmacies across the US
Work closely with our partners, running the deals that come through partner channels
Run expansion sales into pharmacies already live on MedMe, growing adoption across our products
Manage a high volume of concurrent deals and keep them moving
Build direct relationships with pharmacy owners and operators
Bring the voice of the customer back to our product and AI teams, feeding real pharmacist input into what we build and improve next
Hit and exceed a defined new-logo quota

2+ years of closing experience in SaaS, ideally in a high-velocity, lower-ACV motion (SMB or transactional segment)
A track record of hitting quota in a structured, process-driven sales environment
Nice to have: healthcare, pharmacy, or health-tech sales experience; CRM discipline (clean pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting)
Success in This Role Looks Like
30 days: Fully ramped on product, pricing, and process; first deals in active pipeline
60 days: Consistent pipeline coverage against quota; first closed deals
90 days: Hitting quota independently, with a pipeline healthy enough to make the next quarter predictable
Long-term: A reliable closer who makes this funnel a dependable, repeatable source of revenue
How We Hire
MedMe is committed to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates. To ensure that each candidate's journey is consistent and the selection process is unbiased, the team at MedMe will not be responding to any personal messages regarding this role or other opportunities. This role will follow the below Interview Process:
Initial screening conversation with our People and Culture team
Intro interview with the hiring manager

Additional cross-functional interview as required (depending on the role)
References and offer
How We Use AI
At MedMe, we use AI to help us organize and manage applications, so our team can spend their time where it matters most. Every CV is personally reviewed by a human being; AI helps us stay organized, not make decisions. We believe AI should make great people more effective, not replace the thinking and judgment that great hiring requires.

Comprehensive Health Benefits: Full coverage for dental, vision, physical, and mental health.
Professional Development: We support your growth with a yearly budget dedicated to learning opportunities
Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend to help set up and maintain your ideal home office
Office Closure for Holidays: Enjoy 1 week of company-wide office closure during the holidays
Company Retreats: Participate in exciting on-site team retreats for collaboration and bonding
Location
This position would be fully remote. Occasional travel is expected for customer meetings, partner discussions, and industry events.
Equal Opportunity & Accessibility
MedMe is a proud equal opportunity workplace that is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We're looking for motivated and compassionate people who can execute from the ground up and support the work that MedMe believes in.
MedMe is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please inform us and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. For any accessibility-related assistance, requests for information in accessible alternative formats or to report any accessibility problems, please share in your application.
Learn More About MedMe

Account Executive – Influencer Marketing
Location: Remote — Mexico
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time (Contractor)
Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Influencer Marketing / Marketing Technology / Advertising
Compensation: $1,000 – $2,000 USD/month base + uncapped variable compensation (OTE approximately 50/50)
Experience: 2+ years
Languages: Native Spanish + Professional English
Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.
Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics . The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.
Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.
This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion .
You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

Build & Own Your Pipeline
Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG .
Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.
Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.
Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.
Run Full-Cycle Sales
Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.
Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.
Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.
Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.
Build an AI-Native Sales Process
Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.
Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.
Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.
Build the Commercial Playbook
Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.
Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.
Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.
Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.
Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business .
Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.
Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers .
Native Spanish.
Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.
Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel , including follow-up and deal progression.
Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms .
Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands .
Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.
Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.
Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.
This Role Is NOT for You If...
You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.
You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.
You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.
You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.
You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.
Candidate Evaluation Considerations
During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:
Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.
Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.
Full-cycle closing experience.
Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.
Consultative selling and negotiation skills.
Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.
Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.
Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.
What Success Looks Like
You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.
You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.
Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.
New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.
Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.
Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.
Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.
Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy .
Build processes rather than simply inherit them.
Fully remote work across Latin America.
Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.
Occasional travel for important brand meetings.
Important Notes
This is a highly hands-on individual contributor sales role .
Candidates must have personally prospected for new business within the last year.
Candidates should be prepared to discuss previous quota performance and sales results with specific numbers.
Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate how they currently use AI and automation in their sales workflow .

We are seeking an ambitious, self-directed Sales Manager to accelerate revenue growth across the Americas and advance the digitization of the global weather and climate ecosystem. Operating with the autonomy of a regional owner, you will expand Spire’s market presence across key industry segments, leverage our partner ecosystem to drive adoption of our forecast data, APIs, and decision-support solutions, and consistently exceed sales targets.
Two segments sit at the center of this territory. The first is the financial sector — energy and commodity trading desks, hedge funds, and quantitative investment firms that treat weather as a tradable signal and buy differentiated data to sharpen their edge.

The second is the U.S. electric utility and power market: the investor-owned utilities, public power authorities, independent power producers, and grid operators who generate electricity and keep the grid balanced, and for whom forecast accuracy translates directly into load planning, renewable generation, outage response, and reliability.
This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a seller who is energized by how data and software are reshaping traditional industries — and who wants to sell a product that is, quite literally, powered by space.

Own a territory: Build and execute a territory plan spanning the Americas — from Canada and the United States through Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, and South America— identifying and developing new business opportunities while growing and retaining existing client accounts.
Lead with our priority segments: Drive growth in the financial sector — engaging traders, portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and heads of data at trading houses, hedge funds, and asset managers — and across U.S. utilities, IPPs, and grid operators, where you will position Spire’s forecasts against load forecasting, renewable generation, and grid reliability use cases.
Exceed targets: Meet and surpass assigned quotas through disciplined prospecting, qualification, and full-cycle deal execution.
Build lasting relationships: Develop strong, long-term relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders across the weather, climate, and earth intelligence ecosystem — understanding their needs, challenges, and objectives to tailor solutions accordingly.
Sell consultatively: Use a solution-selling approach to uncover clients’ operational pain points and propose tailored offerings built on Spire’s weather forecasts, historical data, and climate analytics.
Master the product: Develop deep expertise in Spire’s data products and platforms — their features, differentiation, and applications — to communicate compelling value to technical and executive audiences alike.
Deliver winning proposals: Prepare and present persuasive sales presentations, proposals, and responses to tenders that clearly articulate Spire’s value proposition.
Negotiate and close: Lead commercial negotiations on terms and pricing to reach mutually beneficial agreements and close deals reliably.
Manage your pipeline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, ensuring rigorous forecasting and timely follow-up on every lead and opportunity.
Know the market: Track industry trends, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and identify new areas for growth.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with marketing, product, meteorology, and customer success teams to ensure client satisfaction and feed market insight back into product development.

8+ years of experience in sales, business development, or account management, with a focus on selling data products, SaaS, or API-based solutions.
A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas.
Strong understanding of the weather and climate industry, or deep experience selling digital transformation into data-driven sectors such as financial markets, power and energy, maritime, aviation, agriculture, or logistics.
Proven success selling data, analytics, or alternative data into the financial sector — commodity, power, or weather derivatives trading desks, hedge funds, or quantitative funds — with the credibility to hold a technical conversation with traders, quants, and research leads and to navigate data-procurement and evaluation processes.
Experience selling into United States electric utilities, independent power producers, or grid operators — with a working understanding of how weather drives generation, load
forecasting, renewable integration, outage and storm response, and grid reliability, and of how utility and public-power procurement cycles work.
A consultative, value-based selling style with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Proven ability to build and maintain trusted client relationships across cultures, time zones, and seniority levels.
Proficiency with modern sales tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Lusha).
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and effective working independently in a remote, globally distributed team.
Fluent in English; willingness to travel across the territory as needed.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, preferably in a high-tech field.
Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

Additional language skills relevant to the Americas — Spanish, Portuguese, or French — are a strong plus, though not required.
An existing network within meteorology, earth observation, or climate-tech communities.
Familiarity with U.S. power market structure and the ISOs/RTOs — PJM, ERCOT, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE — or with FERC and NERC reliability requirements.
An established network on trading floors or among alternative-data buyers at hedge funds and quantitative investment firms.
Experience selling to or partnering with government agencies, national met services, or large enterprises in regulated industries.
Why Spire?
Mission with impact: help organizations worldwide adapt to a changing climate using data collected from space.
Real ownership: a large, high-potential territory with the autonomy to build it your way.
Competitive compensation: base salary plus uncapped commission, and equity participation.
Flexible, remote-first working within a collaborative, international team spanning four continents.
Generous time off, local statutory benefits, and support for professional development. (Specific benefits vary by country of employment.)
Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

Embody Dutchie’s values: It's All About The Customer, “We” Not “I”, Focus On Outcomes, Get There Fast, Embrace Different Perspectives, Get Shit Done, and Be Direct, with Empathy, Utilize First Principles. Become an expert on the New Jersey Cannabis market
